title: Koh Lanta rooftops & high bars
sub: Lanta has almost no real rooftops, so these are the bars up on hills and cliffs. Tick the ones you've done.
tip: Sunset is around 6pm. Sabai Sabai fills up: ring ahead (+66 83 223 5849) and note it's shut on Saturdays. Hill roads are steep, take it slow on the scooter after dark.

places.name: Sabai Sabai Viewpoint & Lounge
notes: Best view on the island, sunset over the green hills to the sea
Book for sunset, every table goes

places.name: The Rock Bar & Restaurant
notes: Clifftop deck down the stairs at Avani+, open to non-guests
Quiet and smart, proper sunset seat

places.name: Nomad Beach Bar
notes: Hippie bar up a steep road above Bamboo Beach, big view
Great Thai food, passion fruit mojitos
Shuts at 8pm, so go for sunset not late night

places.name: View Point Restaurant
notes: Perched high over the east bay and mangroves
Faces east, so it's a daytime/shake stop, not sunset

places.name: Rock Beach Bar
notes: Raised over the rocks with Phi Phi on the horizon
Pool and pool table, cheap drinks
A review says it was mid-renovation, check it's serving
